summary: A focused modal that asks one clarifying question with a few choice buttons.
purpose: Ask a single structuring question before filing the user's input. Reach for it after intake when one choice sharpens the plan; it composes Dialog and full-width Buttons.

anatomy.description: The single question as a centered heading.
A vertical stack of full-width choice buttons.
An optional ghost Skip action when dismissal is allowed.

props.name: onSelectOption
props.description: Called with the chosen option id.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Optional; when set, a Skip action appears and dismissal is allowed.

whenToUse: Asking exactly one question that structures the user's input.
A short, fixed set of choices, roughly two to four.

whenNotToUse.scenario: A general modal for arbitrary content or a flow
A long form with many fields

do: Ask one question at a time.
Keep option labels short and parallel in structure.
dont: Cram multiple questions into one dialog.
Offer more than about four options.

content.voice: Direct, warm, a single plain question. Options in the user's voice.
rules: Two to four parallel option labels.

keyboard: Options are focusable buttons, activatable with Enter or Space.
Escape triggers Skip when onClose is set.
aria: Inherits the modal dialog role from Dialog.
The question is the accessible name.
accessibility.contrast: Question and options hold at least 4.5:1 against the glass.
accessibility.focus: Focus is trapped in the modal and returns to the trigger on close.

examples.title: One clarifying question
examples.code: <ClarifyingDialog open={open} question="Is this mostly time pressure, or emotional weight?" options={opts} onSelectOption={handleSelect} onClose={close} />

related.whenToChoose: Dialog is the general modal; ClarifyingDialog is the one-question specialization.
ChatInput gathers free text; ClarifyingDialog narrows it with a fixed choice.
